about: A 3-day notice for unpaid rent handed over Friday 2026-09-18, stating 'pay or leave by September 21'. The court-day count should skip the weekend and Yom Kippur (Monday 2026-09-21, Eighth Circuit) and give Thursday 2026-09-24. Two bad answers test that the sheet asks again.
start: I rent a house in Gainesville, Alachua County. My rent is $1,850 a month. I did not pay September rent because I lost my job.
On September 18, 2026 the landlord handed me a notice saying I owe $1,850 and must pay or leave by September 21, 2026.
I have not paid anything since, and no court papers have been served on me.

How did the notice reach you: handed to me at my door by the landlord
